# FG-REVIEW-0016

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_ext_check_cannot_be_required` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このチェックは必須にできません。必須にできるのは ci/・kanflow/・forge/ のチェックだけです。
- en: This check cannot be required. Only checks under ci/, kanflow/ or forge/ can be required.
- id: Pemeriksaan ini tidak dapat diwajibkan. Hanya pemeriksaan di bawah ci/, kanflow/, atau forge/ yang dapat diwajibkan.

## 原因 (cause)

A protected ref's merge rule named a required check in a namespace a person can write (`ext/`; ADR-0024 §10, M3 R6): a check a person can report must never satisfy a merge condition, so only the namespaces of service accounts and of forge itself (`ci/`, `kanflow/`, `forge/`) can be required. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=namespace_not_allowed`, `namespace` and `check` (the refused name), with `action=ProtectedRefManage`.

## 対処 (fix)

Require the check under the namespace of the service account that reports it (for example `ci/gates`), or leave it optional.
